# MeowKit

> Enforced discipline for AI coding agents

Hard gates, TDD, security scanning, and human approval — so your AI agent ships production-quality code, not untested prototypes.

## Table of Contents

### Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.meowkit.dev/introduction.md): What MeowKit is, what problem it solves, and how it differs from raw Claude Code.
- [Why MeowKit](https://docs.meowkit.dev/why-meowkit.md): The philosophy behind enforced discipline for AI coding agents.
- [Installation](https://docs.meowkit.dev/installation.md): Install MeowKit and get it running in your project.
- [Quick Start](https://docs.meowkit.dev/quick-start.md): Get from zero to your first MeowKit-managed task in 5 minutes.

### Core Concepts

- [How It Works](https://docs.meowkit.dev/core-concepts/how-it-works.md): The three mechanisms that enforce discipline — rules, hooks, and skills — and how agents compose skills across the workflow.
- [Philosophy](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/philosophy.md): MeowKit's design principles — why the harness matters more than the model, and the trade-offs behind every architectural decision.
- [Workflow Phases (0-6)](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/workflow-phases.md): Detailed breakdown of each phase — deliverables, agents, hooks, and execution modes.
- [Plan Creator Modes and Flags](https://docs.meowkit.dev/core-concepts/plan-creator-modes-and-flags.md): How to choose MeowKit plan-creator modes and flags by workflow risk, context cost, and execution impact.
- [Model Routing](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/model-routing.md): How MeowKit assigns the right AI model tier to each task — Trivial, Standard, or Complex.
- [Memory System](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/memory-system.md): How MeowKit persists learnings across sessions — topic files, immediate capture, pruning.
- [Session State vs Claude Code --resume](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/session-state-vs-resume.md): How MeowKit's session-state layer differs from Claude Code's built-in --resume mechanism. They share a trigger word but operate at different layers and solve different problems.
- [Agent-Skill Architecture](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/agent-skill-architecture.md): How MeowKit agents invoke skills across the 7-phase workflow pipeline.
- [Task System](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/task-system.md)
- [Autobuild Architecture](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/harness-architecture.md): The /mk:autobuild autonomous build pipeline — generator/evaluator split, sprint contract, iteration loop, adaptive density.
- [Adaptive Density](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/adaptive-density.md): How the harness scales scaffolding to model capability — the dead-weight thesis and four density tiers.
- [Rubric Library](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/rubric-library.md): How MeowKit grades builds — the 7 rubrics, composition presets, calibration discipline, and anti-slop anti-patterns.
- [Middleware Layer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/middleware-layer.md): The shell hooks that intercept between model and tools — build verify, loop detection, pre-completion gate, project context loader.
- [Trace & Benchmark Meta-Loop](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/trace-and-benchmark.md): How MeowKit improves itself — trace log, scatter-gather analysis, benchmark canary suite, and dead-weight audit.

### Agents

- [Agents Reference](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents.md): Complete agent roster — 38 specialist agents (12 core, 5 support, 16 Jira, 5 Confluence) with type, role, phase, and activation conditions.
- [orchestrator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/orchestrator.md): Task router — classifies complexity, assigns model tier, detects TDD mode, and routes every request to the right specialist agent.
- [planner](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/planner.md): Planning agent — runs dual product and engineering lens reviews, produces structured plans, and enforces Gate 1 before any code is written.
- [brainstormer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/brainstormer.md): Trade-off analysis agent — evaluates competing solutions with structured pros/cons analysis and synthesizes recommendations for planning.
- [researcher](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/researcher.md): Technology research agent — investigates APIs, libraries, and patterns with a prioritized research chain before making recommendations.
- [architect](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/architect.md): System design specialist — evaluates architectural tradeoffs with evidence and generates Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
- [tester](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/tester.md): Test-writing agent — enforces red-green-refactor discipline in TDD mode and writes behavior-focused tests in default mode.
- [security](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/security.md): Security audit specialist — runs checks at Phase 2 and Phase 4, issues BLOCK verdicts that halt the pipeline for critical vulnerabilities.
- [developer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/developer.md): Implementation agent — writes production code following approved plans. TDD is opt-in. Self-heals up to 3 times.
- [ui-ux-designer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/ui-ux-designer.md): UI/UX design specialist — creates accessible, responsive, production-ready components with WCAG compliance and design system consistency.
- [reviewer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/reviewer.md): 5-dimension structural code review — enforces Gate 2 with written verdicts. Adversarial review with parallel reviewers.
- [evaluator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/evaluator.md): Behavioral verification agent — drives the running build against rubric criteria with real evidence. Skeptic by default.
- [shipper](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/shipper.md): Deployment pipeline agent — executes the full ship sequence from pre-checks through PR creation, CI verification, and rollback documentation.
- [documenter](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/documenter.md): Living documentation agent — keeps project docs in sync with the codebase after every feature completion.
- [analyst](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/analyst.md): Cost tracking and pattern analysis agent — tracks token usage, extracts patterns, and maintains institutional memory across sessions.
- [journal-writer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/journal-writer.md): Post-mortem documentation agent — captures unvarnished accounts of failures, root causes, and lessons learned for institutional memory.
- [git-manager](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/git-manager.md): Git operations specialist — stages, commits, and pushes code with conventional commits and strict safety rules.

### Jira Agents

- [jira-issue](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-issue.md): Jira issue CRUD agent — creates, reads, updates, and deletes individual Jira issues via the jira-as CLI wrapper.
- [jira-search](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-search.md): Jira search and filter agent — runs JQL queries, validates syntax, builds queries from natural language, and manages saved filters.
- [jira-lifecycle](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-lifecycle.md): Jira workflow lifecycle agent — drives transitions, assignments, resolution, and version/component management with workflow discovery.
- [jira-collaborate](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-collaborate.md): Jira collaboration agent — manages comments, attachments, watchers, and notifications with internal-vs-public safety enforcement.
- [jira-relationships](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-relationships.md): Jira issue linking agent — manages links, blockers, dependencies, clones, and bulk-link operations between issues.
- [jira-time](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-time.md): Jira time tracking agent — logs work, manages worklogs, sets estimates, generates time reports, and supports bulk time logging.
- [jira-agile](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-agile.md): Jira agile agent — manages epics, sprints, backlog, ranking, story points, subtasks, and velocity reports.
- [jira-fields](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-fields.md): Jira custom field discovery agent — finds field IDs, lists custom fields, checks project field configurations, and configures agile fields.
- [jira-bulk](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-bulk.md): Jira bulk operations agent — handles transition, assign, priority, clone, and delete operations on 10+ issues with mandatory dry-run.
- [jira-jsm](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-jsm.md): Jira Service Management agent — manages service desks, request types, customer requests, queues, SLAs, approvals, and organizations.
- [jira-admin](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-admin.md): Jira administration agent — manages projects, users, groups, schemes, and automation across 11 sub-domains with admin-level permissions.
- [jira-dev](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-dev.md): Jira developer artifacts agent — generates branch names, PR descriptions, parsed commits, and commit/PR-to-issue links from Jira tickets.
- [jira-ops](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-ops.md): Jira operations agent — manages jira-as cache, validates connectivity, and discovers project context. Diagnostic-only, no Atlassian state changes.
- [jira-evaluator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-evaluator.md): Jira ticket complexity evaluator — scores tickets across 8 dimensions for complexity, inconsistencies, and quality with read-only analysis.
- [jira-estimator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-estimator.md): Jira story point estimator — produces heuristic estimates using complexity analysis, historical data, and team velocity context.
- [jira-analyst](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/jira-analyst.md): Jira ticket analyst — performs full context analysis including attached media (images, PDFs, screenshots) and linked issues for root cause investigation.
- [story-sizer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/story-sizer.md): Pre-ticket Fibonacci sizing agent for paste-mode batches of user stories. Read-only at Jira; auto-create delegates ticket creation to peer skills.

### Confluence Agents

- [confluence-page](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/confluence-page.md): Confluence page CRUD agent — creates, reads, updates, and deletes individual pages, plus hierarchy + version + copy/move ops via the confluence-as CLI wrapper.
- [confluence-search](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/confluence-search.md): Confluence search agent — runs CQL queries, validates CQL, lists spaces, manages saved filters, and exports results via the confluence-as CLI wrapper.
- [confluence-spec-analyst](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/confluence-spec-analyst.md): Confluence spec analyst — reads a page and its children, runs gap-detection heuristics, and produces a structured Spec Research Report. Read-only at Confluence side; persists report locally.
- [confluence-bulk](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/confluence-bulk.md): Confluence bulk operations agent — bulk-label / bulk-move / bulk-delete across 10+ pages via the confluence-as CLI wrapper. Mandatory dry-run ceremony.
- [confluence-collaborate](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/confluence-collaborate.md): Confluence collaboration agent — manages comments, attachments, labels, and watchers on individual pages via the confluence-as CLI wrapper.

### Autobuild Pipeline

- [mk:autobuild](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/autobuild.md): Autonomous green-field build pipeline — planner, contract, generator/evaluator loop with adaptive density.
- [mk:sprint-contract](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/sprint-contract.md): Negotiates a file-based sprint contract between generator and evaluator before code is written — BDD acceptance criteria, rubric bindings, git-signed agreement.
- [mk:evaluate](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/evaluate.md): Behavioral active verification — drives running build via browser/curl/CLI and grades against rubric criteria with concrete evidence. Owned by the evaluator agent (Phase 3+).
- [mk:rubric](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/rubric.md): Rubric library API — load, list, compose, and validate graded evaluation rubrics with PASS/WARN/FAIL grading and balanced anchor examples.
- [mk:trace-analyze](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/trace-analyze.md): Scatter-gather trace log analysis — partitions run records, scatters to parallel researchers, surfaces recurring patterns with mandatory human gate.
- [mk:benchmark](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/benchmark.md): Harness canary suite — measures harness performance against ground-truth tasks. Backs the dead-weight audit with measured deltas.

### Pipeline Skills

- [Skills Reference](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills.md): Complete skill index — all skills organized by workflow phase with brief descriptions.
- [mk:cook](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/cook.md): End-to-end feature pipeline — plan, test, build, review, ship. TDD is opt-in via --tdd.
- [mk:fix](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/fix.md): Structured bug investigation — auto-complexity detection, root cause analysis, mandatory regression tests.
- [mk:ship](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/ship.md): Fully automated ship workflow — merge base, run tests, review, bump version, changelog, commit, push, PR.
- [mk:resolving-merge-conflicts](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/resolving-merge-conflicts.md): Resolve an in-progress git merge or rebase conflict end to end — read state, recover each side's intent, resolve hunks, run checks, finish the merge/rebase.
- [mk:verify](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/verify.md): Unified verification: build -> lint -> test -> type-check -> coverage. Use for 'is everything green', 'run all checks', 'verify build'. Auto-called by mk:cook.
- [mk:loop](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/loop.md): Bounded, git-tracked optimization loop. Improve one scalar metric (coverage, bundle size, lint count, latency) by iterating: modify one scoped change, verify, keep or revert. Boundary-gated autonomy.
- [mk:workflow-orchestrator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/workflow-orchestrator.md): Auto-invoked 7-phase workflow coordinator for complex features — phase routing, token budget management, gate enforcement, fast-track mode.
- [mk:session-continuation](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/session-continuation.md): mk:session-continuation

### Quality & Review

- [mk:review](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/review.md): Multi-pass structural code review with adversarial analysis, scope-aware dispatch, adversarial persona passes, and forced-finding protocol. Supports branch diff, PR number, commit hash, and pending changes.
- [mk:review-pr](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/review-pr.md): Review a GitHub PR with a single shallow correctness/security/breaking/AI-slop checklist and emit a verdict; optionally post it via gh pr review.
- [mk:respond-pr](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/respond-pr.md): Triage reviewer comments on a GitHub PR with receiving-review discipline — verify each against the codebase, then accept/push-back/clarify, and optionally reply in-thread.
- [mk:elicit](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/elicit.md): Structured second-pass reasoning — re-examine review verdicts, plans, or analyses through named methods (pre-mortem, red team, Socratic, inversion, first principles, and more).
- [mk:nyquist](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/nyquist.md): Test-to-requirement coverage mapping — reads plan acceptance criteria and test files, produces a coverage gap report showing which requirements have no tests.
- [mk:cso](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/cso.md): Chief Security Officer — infrastructure-first security audit. Two modes: daily (zero-noise, 8/10 confidence gate) and comprehensive (monthly deep scan, 2/10 bar). Covers secrets archaeology, dependency supply chain, CI/CD pipeline, LLM/AI security, OWASP Top 10, STRIDE threat modeling, and active verification.
- [mk:vulnerability-scanner](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/vulnerability-scanner.md): OWASP Top 10 vulnerability scanning — attack surface mapping, risk prioritization, supply chain security, code pattern analysis. NOT for STRIDE/CSO-mode infrastructure audits (use mk:cso).
- [mk:clean-code](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/clean-code.md): Pragmatic coding standards — KISS, DRY, YAGNI, SRP, Boy Scout. For ad-hoc quality reviews at any phase. NOT for post-hoc diff/PR review (use mk:review) or behavior-preserving simplification (use mk:simplify).
- [mk:lint-and-validate](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/lint-and-validate.md): Automatic linting and static analysis after code changes. Runs linter + type-check + shared validation scripts. MANDATORY after every code change.
- [mk:simplify](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/simplify.md): Post-implementation simplification pass — reduces complexity without changing behavior. Runs after Phase 3 GREEN, before Phase 4 Review.
- [mk:improve-codebase-architecture](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/improve-codebase-architecture.md): Review a codebase for deepening opportunities (shallow modules → deep), emit structured candidates for mk:preview to render, then grill a pick into a precise, type-safe patch. Analysis and patch emission only — no embedded rendering.

### Planning & Design

- [mk:plan-creator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/plan-creator.md): Creates structured multi-file implementation plans before any code is written — scope detection, research, codebase analysis, semantic checks, red-teaming, validation interview.
- [mk:validate-plan](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/validate-plan.md): mk:validate-plan
- [mk:plan-ceo-review](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/plan-ceo-review.md): mk:plan-ceo-review
- [mk:office-hours](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/office-hours.md): mk:office-hours
- [mk:brainstorming](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/brainstorming.md): mk:brainstorming
- [mk:grill](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/grill.md): Relentlessly interview the user about their own plan or design — one question at a time — resolving each branch of a decision tree until shared understanding. Claude is the interviewer; the user is the interviewee. Checkpoints every answer to docs/knowledge/<slug>.md so progress survives a context reset, flags unanswerable knowledge as gaps to chase, and ends by offering three handoffs. Read-only on the source doc.
- [mk:prompt-enhancer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/prompt-enhancer.md): Refine a draft user prompt — default returns only the rewritten prompt. Pass --analyze to surface decomposition, 10-item weakness detection, and improvement notes. Pass --score (with --analyze) for a deterministic 1–10 quality score. Rewrite uses the universal kernel (plain markdown, no XML, no vendor tokens). Auto-suggests freedom level and verbosity. Optional --deep flag scouts allow-listed sources for [FILL-IN] placeholder candidates.
- [mk:party](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/party.md): Multi-agent deliberation for architecture decisions and trade-off analysis — 2-4 agent perspectives with mandatory decision writing.
- [mk:decision-framework](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/decision-framework.md): mk:decision-framework
- [mk:intake](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/intake.md): Ticket/PRD intake: product area classification, completeness scoring, RCA, technical assessment. Works with Jira/Linear/GitHub via MCP or manual paste.

### Exploration & Research

- [mk:ask-me](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/ask-me.md): Evidence-grounded project Q&A — answers "how does X work here", "why is X structured this way", and "is this claim true in the repo" with cited file:line evidence. Three depth tiers with hard read budgets. Read-only by default; redirects ideation, decisions, debugging, and reviews to the owning specialist skill instead of partially answering.
- [mk:scout](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/scout.md): mk:scout
- [mk:investigate](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/investigate.md): Systematic debugging with root cause investigation. Four phases: investigate, analyze, hypothesize, implement. Iron Law: no fixes without root cause.
- [mk:docs-finder](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/docs-finder.md): Script-first documentation discovery — retrieves up-to-date library, framework, and API docs via Context7 (llms.txt), Context Hub (chub), WebSearch, and web-to-markdown with intelligent 4-tier fallback.
- [mk:web-to-markdown](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/web-to-markdown.md): Fetch arbitrary URLs and return clean markdown with 8-layer injection defense. For external pages (blogs, RFCs, GitHub issues, vendor docs) not covered by curated indexes. Static-only by default with opt-in JS rendering.
- [mk:sequential-thinking](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/sequential-thinking.md): Structured step-by-step reasoning before acting. Prevents jumping to conclusions or guessing root causes without evidence. Used by mk:fix diagnosis phase.
- [mk:problem-solving](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/problem-solving.md): Use when stuck on approach (not debugging). Strategic unsticking via 7 non-default techniques: simplification cascades, collision-zone thinking, meta-pattern recognition, inversion, scale game, first principles, via negativa.
- [mk:chom](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/chom.md): Analyze external systems, repos, apps, or ideas and produce a spec for replicating them in your project.
- [mk:henshin](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/henshin.md): Transform existing code into agent-consumable surfaces — CLI (npm-publishable), MCP server, and companion skill.
- [mk:pack](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/pack.md): Pack an EXTERNAL repository into a single AI-friendly file (markdown/xml/json). Use for third-party library analysis, security audits, or handoff to external LLMs.

### Browser & QA

- [mk:qa-manual](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/qa-manual.md): Spec-driven manual QA testing and Playwright E2E code generation. Orchestrates browser skills to navigate apps like a human tester, producing structured test reports or production-ready .spec.ts files.
- [mk:qa](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/qa.md): Systematically QA test a web application and fix bugs found. Runs QA testing, then iteratively fixes bugs in source code, committing each fix atomically and re-verifying.
- [mk:agent-browser](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/agent-browser.md): AI-agent-driven browser automation via Chrome/CDP for long autonomous sessions — auth-heavy flows, session persistence, annotated screenshots, video recording, and 100+ commands.
- [mk:playwright-cli](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/playwright-cli.md): Session-persistent browser automation via Playwright CLI — form filling, screenshots, data extraction, multi-step flows.

### Frontend

- [mk:typescript](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/typescript.md): Strict TypeScript patterns for type safety, null handling, and modern best practices. Auto-activates on .ts/.tsx files.
- [mk:vue](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/vue.md): Vue 3 Composition API patterns — Pinia state management, reactivity, component design, forms, performance. Auto-activates on .vue files.
- [mk:vue-best-practices](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/vue-best-practices.md): Deep Vue 3 best-practices review, recommendations, and the full ordered authoring workflow — built-in components (Teleport, Suspense, KeepAlive, Transition, TransitionGroup), animation techniques, slots, fallthrough attrs, custom directives, async components, render functions, plugins, and the post-functionality performance pass. Invoke-only; complements mk:vue.
- [mk:vue-testing-best-practices](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/vue-testing-best-practices.md): Vue 3 testing best-practices review and recommendations — designing and auditing Vitest + Vue Test Utils tests for components, composables, Pinia stores, Vue Router, async/Suspense, Teleport, forms, and accessibility, plus Playwright E2E test-design strategy. Advisory/review only — recommends patterns and flags test smells; does not run tests. Complements mk:vue-best-practices.
- [mk:angular](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/angular.md): Angular v20+ patterns — standalone components, signals, dependency injection, forms, routing, HTTP, testing, SSR, tooling.
- [mk:react-patterns](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/react-patterns.md): React/Next.js performance optimization — waterfall elimination, bundle optimization, re-render reduction. Context-aware rules across 5 priority categories.
- [mk:frontend-design](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/frontend-design.md): Production-grade UI/UX design — anti-AI-slop enforcement, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, typography, color, motion, responsive. Design tokens and visual quality.
- [mk:ui-design-system](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/ui-design-system.md): Data-driven design intelligence — 160 palettes, 73 font pairings, 161 product types, 98 UX guidelines, WCAG 2.1 AA quality checklists.
- [mk:stitch](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/stitch.md): Generate novel UI designs from a text prompt via Stitch AI. Exports Tailwind/HTML, PNG screenshot, and DESIGN.md for mk:frontend-design handoff.

### Backend & Data

- [mk:api-design](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/api-design.md): REST and GraphQL API design patterns — resource naming, HTTP methods, status codes, pagination, versioning, error formats.
- [mk:build-fix](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/build-fix.md): Universal build error resolver — detects language, loads fix patterns, classifies by fixability, auto-retries up to 3 attempts. Chains into mk:verify.
- [mk:database](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/database.md): Database patterns — schema design, safe migrations, query optimization, and indexing. PostgreSQL primary; patterns apply to MySQL and SQLite.

### Analysis & Media

- [mk:multimodal](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/multimodal.md): Process and generate images, video, audio, PDFs, and speech via Gemini and MiniMax APIs. Image analysis, transcription, OCR, document conversion, image/video/music generation with multi-provider fallback.
- [mk:llms](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/llms.md): Generate llms.txt and llms-full.txt files from project documentation following the llmstxt.org spec — LLM-friendly markdown indexes that make projects discoverable by AI assistants.
- [mk:preview](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/preview.md): Generate visual artifacts — markdown or self-contained HTML — for explanations, diagrams, slide decks, and git diffs. Display only; not for plan rendering or plan critique.
- [mk:visual-plan](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/visual-plan.md): Render a plan (plan.md + phase-*.md) into ONE self-contained, template-consistent plan.html a reviewer can scan in under 30 seconds. Block-disciplined, shareable, no backend.
- [mk:mermaidjs-v11](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/mermaidjs-v11.md): Create inline Mermaid v11 diagram blocks — flowcharts, sequence, class, ER, Gantt, state, timeline, and 20+ other types — rendered in markdown and browser environments. Zero external dependencies.
- [mk:tech-graph](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/tech-graph.md): Generate publish-grade SVG+PNG technical diagrams — architecture, data flow, flowchart, sequence, agent-memory, class, ER, state-machine, comparison, timeline, and more — across 8 visual styles. Output goes to tasks/visuals/ or an active plan's visuals/ directory.
- [mk:markdown-reader](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/markdown-reader.md): Serve any markdown file or directory as a calm, book-like reader via a local HTTP server (127.0.0.1 only). For long-form documents: RFCs, runbooks, design docs, plan files.
- [mk:showcase](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/showcase.md): Create a self-contained, visually polished HTML showcase page for a topic or set of artifacts. Supply a mission and optional artifact paths explicitly — the skill never auto-scans the repo.

### Safety & Scoping

- [mk:careful](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/careful.md): Session-scoped safety guardrails for destructive commands with environment-aware blocking — warns or blocks rm -rf, DROP TABLE, force-push, git reset --hard, kubectl delete, terraform destroy, and more.
- [mk:freeze](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/freeze.md): Session-scoped edit restriction — blocks Edit and Write tools outside an allowed directory. Gate for preventing accidental scope creep during debugging or focused work.
- [mk:skill-template-secure](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/skill-template-secure.md): Secure skill template with prompt injection defenses, trust model, Rule of Two classification, and content processing rules. Copy this template when creating new skills.

### Infrastructure

- [mk:agent-detector](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/agent-detector.md): mk:agent-detector
- [mk:lazy-agent-loader](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/lazy-agent-loader.md): mk:lazy-agent-loader
- [mk:scale-routing](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/scale-routing.md): mk:scale-routing
- [mk:skill-creator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/skill-creator.md): Create new skills with proper structure, compliance checks, and registration. Enforces mk: prefix and context engineering principles.
- [mk:project-organization](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/project-organization.md): Standardize file locations, naming conventions, and directory structure. Two modes: advisory (return correct path) and organize (restructure).
- [mk:bootstrap](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/bootstrap.md): End-to-end project orchestrator — research -> design -> plan -> scaffold -> implement -> docs. For new projects from scratch. Explicit invocation only.
- [mk:worktree](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/worktree.md): Git worktree management for parallel agent execution. Creates isolated worktrees for parallel agents, merges results, audits health, prunes stale metadata, and cleans up.
- [mk:context-audit](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/context-audit.md): Read-only audit of .claude/ structural overhead — reports prioritized 'remove X save Y tokens' recommendations against the model context window.

### Jira (Router + Family)

- [mk:jira](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira.md): Routing skill — recommends the correct mk:jira-* leaf for any Jira task. Pure router; no execution.
- [mk:jira-issue](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-issue.md): JIRA issue CRUD via the jira-as wrapper. Forks the jira-issue agent.
- [mk:jira-search](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-search.md): JIRA search + saved-filter management via the jira-as wrapper.
- [mk:jira-lifecycle](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-lifecycle.md): Drive JIRA workflow lifecycle via the jira-as wrapper. Cache-first transition discovery.
- [mk:jira-collaborate](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-collaborate.md): Manage JIRA collaboration: comments, attachments, watchers, notifications. Internal-vs-public comment safety enforced.
- [mk:jira-relationships](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-relationships.md): Manage JIRA issue relationships: link, unlink, blockers, dependencies, clone, bulk-link.
- [mk:jira-time](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-time.md): JIRA time tracking: log work, list/edit/delete worklogs, set estimates, generate reports.
- [mk:jira-agile](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-agile.md): JIRA agile: epics, sprints, backlog, ranking, story points, subtasks, velocity.
- [mk:jira-fields](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-fields.md): JIRA custom field discovery + agile field configuration.
- [mk:jira-bulk](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-bulk.md): Bulk JIRA operations on 10+ issues. Dry-run is mandatory. Reads workflow cache.
- [mk:jira-jsm](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-jsm.md): JIRA Service Management: service desks, requests, customers, queues, SLAs, approvals. Requires JSM license.
- [mk:jira-admin](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-admin.md): JIRA project / user / group / scheme / automation administration. Requires admin. Highest blast radius.
- [mk:jira-dev](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-dev.md): Generate developer artifacts from Jira tickets: branch names, PR descriptions, parsed commits, link commits/PRs.
- [mk:jira-ops](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-ops.md): JIRA-side cache + project-context discovery. Diagnostic surface only.
- [mk:jira-evaluator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-evaluator.md): Read-only ticket complexity + inconsistency analysis. Persists report for downstream skills.
- [mk:jira-estimator](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-estimator.md): Read-only heuristic story-point estimation. Auto-consumes prior evaluator output.
- [mk:jira-analyst](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/jira-analyst.md): Read-only full ticket context analysis including media. Persists structured RCA report.
- [mk:story-sizer](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/story-sizer.md): Pre-ticket Fibonacci sizing for a paste-mode batch of user stories. Default writes an advisory Story Sizing Report. Opt-in --auto-create delegates ticket creation behind a single confirmation gate.

### Confluence (Router + Family)

- [mk:confluence](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/confluence.md): Routing skill — recommends the correct mk:confluence-* leaf for any Confluence Cloud task. Pure router; no execution.
- [mk:confluence-page](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/confluence-page.md): Confluence page CRUD via the confluence-as wrapper. Forks the confluence-page agent.
- [mk:confluence-search](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/confluence-search.md): Confluence CQL search + space list + saved-filter + export via the confluence-as wrapper. Forks the confluence-search agent.
- [mk:confluence-spec-analyst](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/confluence-spec-analyst.md): Deep spec analysis of a Confluence page (+ children + images). Produces a structured Spec Research Report. Forks the confluence-spec-analyst agent.
- [mk:confluence-bulk](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/confluence-bulk.md): Bulk Confluence operations on 10+ pages via the confluence-as wrapper. Forks the confluence-bulk agent. Dry-run is mandatory.
- [mk:confluence-collaborate](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/confluence-collaborate.md): Manage Confluence collaboration surface — comments, attachments, labels, watchers — via the confluence-as wrapper. Forks the confluence-collaborate agent.

### External Integrations

- [mk:figma](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/figma.md): Figma design analysis and implementation via Figma MCP. Parse Figma links, extract design specs, translate to code.

### Documentation & Release

- [mk:docs-init](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/docs-init.md): Generate initial project documentation from codebase analysis — creates docs/ from scratch. For new projects or empty docs directories.
- [mk:document-release](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/document-release.md): Post-ship documentation sync — updates all project docs to match shipped code, polishes changelog, cleans up TODOs.
- [mk:retro](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/retro.md): Weekly-cadence engineering retrospective — analyzes commit history, work patterns, and code quality metrics with persistent history, trend tracking, and team-aware breakdowns. Supports compare mode and cross-project global mode.

### Knowledge & Wiki

- [mk:wiki](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/wiki.md): Capture, gate, query, and render long-term project knowledge through the gated mewkit wiki subsystem.
- [mk:wiki-research](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/wiki-research.md): Fetch external sources (web / arXiv / GitHub) and turn them into scanner-gated wiki candidates — never canonical pages.
- [mk:wiki-render](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/wiki-render.md): Render a wiki into ONE self-contained HTML snapshot (pages + provenance) that opens offline — no CDN, no remote assets.

### Reference Toolkits

- [mk:development](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/development.md): Implementation toolkit — code patterns by stack, TDD enforcement (opt-in via --tdd), and on-demand skill loading. Used by the developer agent in Phase 2-3.
- [mk:memory](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/memory.md): Session memory toolkit — capture learnings, extract patterns, track costs, and consolidate stale entries. Persists to .claude/memory/ topic files. Activates during Phase 0 (Orient) to load context and Phase 6 (Reflect) to persist it.
- [mk:testing](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/testing.md): Test writing toolkit — TDD red-green-refactor, validation scripts, visual QA, and E2E best practices. Used by the tester agent during Phase 2-3.

### Workflows

- [Workflows Overview](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows.md): Step-by-step guides for common development scenarios with MeowKit.
- [Starting a New Project](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/new-project.md): Set up MeowKit in a new or existing project and run your first task.
- [Adding a Feature](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/add-feature.md): Build a feature from plan to PR using MeowKit's full pipeline.
- [Autonomous Green-Field Build](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/autonomous-build.md): Use mk:autobuild to build a green-field product end-to-end with generator/evaluator loop and adaptive scaffolding.
- [Fixing a Bug](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/fix-bug.md): Investigate, fix, and verify a bug with root cause analysis and regression testing.
- [Code Review](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/code-review.md): Multi-pass code review with adversarial analysis, scope drift detection, and automated fixes.
- [Shipping Code](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/ship-code.md): The complete ship pipeline from tests to PR with adversarial review and issue linking.
- [Security Audit](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/security-audit.md): Run a comprehensive security audit with OWASP, STRIDE, supply chain, and platform-specific scanning.
- [Refactoring](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/refactoring.md): Safely refactor code with test coverage verification and architectural review.
- [Writing Tests](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/writing-tests.md): Write unit tests and E2E tests following TDD methodology.
- [QA Testing](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/qa-testing.md): Manual QA testing and Playwright E2E code generation with browser automation.
- [Documentation](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/documentation.md): Generate and maintain project documentation with diff-aware syncing and changelog generation.
- [Sprint Retrospective](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/retrospective.md): Run a team-aware engineering retrospective with commit analysis and trend tracking.
- [Agile / Scrum Workflow](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/agile-scrum.md): Sprint goal, DoR/DoD, retro→action loop, and spike governance via the Agile conditional rule layer.
- [Architecture Decisions](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/architecture.md): Evaluate architectural tradeoffs and document decisions with ADRs.
- [Frontend Development](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/frontend.md): Build frontend features with Vue 3, TypeScript, and UI/UX design standards.
- [Researching Libraries](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/research.md): Evaluate libraries, frameworks, and technical approaches with structured findings.
- [Maintaining Old Projects](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/maintenance.md): Navigate, understand, and fix issues in unfamiliar or legacy codebases.
- [PRD Intake Automation](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/prd-intake.md): Analyze incoming PRDs/tickets with MeowKit as the AI engine, powered by the mk:jira leaf family.
- [Analyzing Tickets with Media](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/ticket-with-media.md): How MeowKit handles tickets containing screenshots, videos, Figma links, and documents.
- [Ticket Evaluation & Estimation](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/ticket-evaluation.md): Assess ticket complexity, detect issues, and estimate story points with the mk:jira intelligence leaves.
- [Tickets to Sprint Planning](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/spec-to-sprint.md): Research-driven workflow from ticket evaluation through codebase review to sprint planning.
- [Ticket to Code](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/ticket-to-code.md): Developer workflow from receiving a Jira ticket through understanding, planning, implementing, and shipping.
- [Spec → PR: Behind the Scenes](https://docs.meowkit.dev/workflows/spec-to-pr-walkthrough.md): A guided walkthrough showing what each MeowKit skill actually does as you take a Confluence spec all the way to a merged PR — prompts, agent handoffs, gates, and report shapes.

### Other

- [Autonomous Build](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guides/autonomous-build.md): Green-field product builds with /mk:autobuild — planner, sprint contract, generator/evaluator loop with adaptive density.
- [Build a Feature](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guides/build-a-feature.md): Step-by-step guide to building features with /mk:cook — from plan to ship.
- [Changelog](https://docs.meowkit.dev/changelog.md): MeowKit release history and changes.
- [Cheatsheet](https://docs.meowkit.dev/cheatsheet.md): Dense quick reference for all MeowKit commands, agents, skills, and workflow phases.
- [Debug Effectively](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guides/debug-effectively.md): Decision guide — when to use mk:fix, mk:investigate, mk:sequential-thinking, or mk:problem-solving.
- [Fix a Bug](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guides/fix-a-bug.md): Structured bug investigation with /mk:fix — root cause analysis, regression tests, and memory capture.
- [Gates & Security](https://docs.meowkit.dev/core-concepts/gates.md): How Gate 1 and Gate 2 enforce discipline, and how MeowKit's 4-layer security model prevents prompt injection.
- [MeowKit Documentation — Audience Definition](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/audience-definition.md)
- [MeowKit Documentation — Infrastructure Audit](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/infrastructure-audit.md)
- [Migration Guide](https://docs.meowkit.dev/migration.md): Export MeowKit to external coding-agent tools (Cursor, Codex, Droid, OpenCode, and more) — and recover when things go sideways.
- [mk:browse (removed)](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/browse.md): Retired. Superseded by mk:agent-browser.
- [mk:help](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/help.md): Navigation assistant — scans project state (plans, reviews, tests, git, checkpoint/budget/model/verdict sources) and ranks the top next steps in the 7-phase pipeline.
- [mk:planning-engine](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/planning-engine.md): Analyzes ticket complexity and maps dependencies against existing codebase before sprint planning — capacity estimation, dependency graphing, tech review.
- [mk:project-context](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/project-context.md): mk:project-context
- [mk:task-queue](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/task-queue.md): Task claiming and ownership tracking for parallel agent execution — agents claim tasks from a shared queue with file ownership enforcement.
- [mk:team-config](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/skills/team-config.md): Set up parallel agent team for COMPLEX tasks — creates worktree structure, generates ownership map, initializes task queue.
- [project-manager](https://docs.meowkit.dev/reference/agents/project-manager.md): Delivery tracker agent — produces on-demand status reports by scanning plans, verdicts, contracts, cost logs, and git history.
- [Review Code](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guides/review-code.md): Multi-pass adversarial code review with /mk:review — 5 dimensions, parallel reviewers, and structured verdicts.
- [Ship Safely](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guides/ship-safely.md): Deploy with /mk:ship — conventional commits, PR creation, CI verification, and rollback documentation.
- [TDD is now optional](https://docs.meowkit.dev/migration/tdd-optional.md): Migration guide for the TDD-optional change. TDD enforcement is now opt-in via --tdd / MEOWKIT_TDD=1.
- [Understanding MeowKit's Harness](https://docs.meowkit.dev/guide/understanding-the-harness.md): Merged into How MeowKit Works.
- [What Is MeowKit](https://docs.meowkit.dev/core-concepts/what-is-meowkit.md): What MeowKit is, what problem it solves, and why the harness matters more than the model.
- [Workflow Phases](https://docs.meowkit.dev/core-concepts/workflow.md): The canonical 7-phase pipeline. Every task flows through these phases with two hard gates requiring human approval.
